title: Mutable authenticated peer SCHC context can bypass version mismatch policy
description: Rule 7 and versioning correctness rereview: AuthenticatedPeerSchcContext is a frozen dataclass but callers can mutate remote_version with object.__setattr__. A context issued for incompatible version 2 can be changed to 3 and its public compress_packet or decompress_packet methods then enable compressed and fragmented-compatible behavior outside the owning LinkLayer policy. Bind operational use to an unforgeable LinkLayer-issued immutable snapshot or make the context an opaque policy handle validated by its owner on every use. Add version-flip, signer-flip, exact forgery, stale replacement, and valid-context tests proving mismatches remain Rule-255-only.
